hypothesis: Expanding standalone WW (weld-weld) notation into Russian welded-connection vocabulary in the additive retrieval query will improve recall for terse technical tenders without changing selection semantics.
why_now: The scored welded-valve notation failure has verified catalog matches, while the accepted Cycle 3 canonicalizer currently leaves WW untouched. This is a bounded query-time experiment with no index rebuild.
expected_effect: Surface welded candidates while preserving original retrieval, reranker input, output text, and fail-open behavior.
expected_metric_gain: +3.3 pp public hard-pass is plausible; blind improvement is uncertain but credible for analogous notation.
lesson_from_history: Cycles 1–2 showed selection-adjacent constraint changes can regress coverage/safety. Cycle 3 improved both public and blind metrics through additive deterministic canonicalization, so this is a narrow extension of the successful mechanism.
candidate_hypotheses: Add flange subtype semantics to the deterministic schema.
plan_summary: Created and strict-validated proposal, capability spec, design, and implementation-only tasks in openspec/changes/cycle-04-connection-notation-canonicalization/. No product code was changed.
